product_one_liner.value: Speak_ is an AI recruiting platform for hiring teams that evaluates and ranks applicants’ resumes against recruiter-defined criteria, helping teams screen candidates faster.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes AI-powered resume screening and hiring-team workflows.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists Free ($0), Pro ($199/month), and custom-priced Enterprise plans.

named_customers.notes: All three are named in customer testimonials on the homepage.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn profile lists 18 employees. (The displayed company-size range is 11–50; the selected allowed band is the closest supported band.)

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists Boulder, Colorado; PitchBook provides a Boulder, Colorado address.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains recruiting, candidate-experience, and career-related editorial content; it does not show at least two technical posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: A public multi-article guide site exists, with multiple organized sections and articles. Its subject is interview preparation rather than API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No company-specific, current Speak_ recruiting careers page or live job board was found to establish whether AI/ML roles are open.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the available product, blog, and public guide search results; no public model or provider declaration was found. The site did not expose an AI/security FAQ or subprocessor list identifying one.

compliance_certs.notes: The homepage provides no security/trust page or certification information, and no public legal/security page naming any of the listed certifications was found.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook identifies a completed $300,000 seed round dated May 1, 2023; this was later than the listed $1 million seed in December 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: The listed most recent completed priced round is May 2023, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09. A 2025 accelerator entry is separately listed without an amount and is not identified as a funding round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No company-specific live careers page or job board was found from which to verify current openings.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog index shows recruiting/editorial content and no launch-type product announcement in the six-month window; its newest listed topic is about recruiting trends in 2024.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The accessible team information does not establish who joined or left within the period, and no dated C-level or VP-level change announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The homepage explicitly identifies these systems as ATS integrations.
